turns.question: How many customers did we have in September 2026?
turns.answer: "Customers" has three meanings, so here are all three for 1 to 30 September 2026: signups (customers who signed up in the period) 9 customers; active customers (distinct customers with a non-cancelled order in the period) 10 customers; and customers to date (everyone signed up by 30 September) 30 customers. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
